observed_symptoms.description: Partner is out of sync for interface 1/1/3 LAG sport: 1. Actor state: ALFOX, partner state PSFO
Partner is lost (timed out) for interface 1/1/3 LAG sport: 1. State: Expired State -> Defaulted State
VSX ISL port lag256 is Out-Of-Sync with the peer: link is down

raw_details.recommended_action: Check the configuration of interface 1/1/3 and ensure that it is properly configured and synchronized with the partner. Verify that the LACP (Link Aggregation Control Protocol) parameters are correctly set and that the partner is responding as expected. If the issue persists, consider resetting the interface and re-establishing the LACP negotiation.

comp_details.recommended_action: Review and correct the configuration for the affected component.

ground_truth.recommended_action: Restart the BFD session and verify the interface state.
